She has never been obsessed with Disney stuff (our daughters loved Disney when they were little, but they’re out of the house now.) I suppose my wife always enjoyed Disney stuff but I assumed it was mostly for their sake. I want to have an intervention where we stop all the Disney stuff and just go to counseling which should have happened a while ago. AITA for wanting to back out?
